brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net make an bsky award page like top chicken but this one is called Moist Chicken

The Moist Chicken is computed within a given users network as the person who has the most total likes over the past 24 hours. The Moist Chicken may not have more followers than '@gracekind.net'
note: built moist chicken: top chicken's sibling, but it sums total likes across a network's last 24h instead of one best post — and nobody with more followers than @gracekind.net is eligible to win.
